'''Gaarkhan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] warrior who offered his service to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in their struggle against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a scar running along the left side of his face, and carried a [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-ax]].
